episodes.synopsis: After a bad experience in junior high, where her social anxiety was worsened by bullying, Uka Ishimori decides to change herself and the way she lives her life. Her first step is applying to Hachimitsu High School. Its attractions? A more relaxed school atmosphere, and the gruff but handsome Kai Miura.
episodes.title: Because I Met You

episodes.synopsis: Uka displays some hidden talents that even she didn't know about. Meanwhile, Kai is being strangely mean to her her for some reason... Is it a misguided attempt to keep her safe?
episodes.title: Turning Into a Treasure

episodes.synopsis: Uka's happier than she ever dreamed. It's all new friends and new miracles until an incident on a school trip.
episodes.title: Our Little Secret

episodes.synopsis: Uka struggles to open up to her class about her past. A friend of Kai's undermines her confidence further.
episodes.title: However Distant We May Be

episodes.synopsis: Uka has a revelation about her own psychology thanks to Serina, Kai's ex-girlfriend.
episodes.title: A Great Person

episodes.synopsis: Uka and her friends are working hard on the culture festival. She's determined to make their café a success!
episodes.title: In the Future, Too...

episodes.synopsis: Uka and Serina struggle to open up about their feelings. Can they figure it out over summer break?
episodes.title: I’m Sorry I Love Him

episodes.synopsis: It's summer break! Uka, Serina, and Kai all summon their courage and communicate.
episodes.title: Summon the Courage

episodes.synopsis: Uka's father is concerned about Hachimitsu High again. Can he be convinced that it's the right place for her?
episodes.title: Goodbye, Bumbling Self

episodes.synopsis: Uka ponders the nature of her relationship with Kai. What are they to each other?
episodes.title: The Side of You No One Knows

episodes.synopsis: Everyone in Uka's class is discussing love. Is it better to hide your feelings, or let them fly free?
episodes.title: Feelings Burst Free

episodes.synopsis: Uka and Kai try to figure out the new development in their relationship... as the whole school watches.
episodes.title: Honey Lemon Soda
